status: Native live acceptance passed: two temporary user submissions, each with an exact-ID conduit refresh; saved-history GET returned 404 and recent history omitted the conversation. Both feature release gates remain closed.

sources.contract: Temporary chats remain outside history unless explicitly saved; backend retention is separate from local persistence.

request.body: conversation_id and offset=0; no messages, model selection or persistence-mode change
request.conduit: Only the token from response header or resume_conversation_token event; never the preparation token
request.retry: One explicit read attempt; no automatic replay, POST retry, tokenless fallback or conversion to saved

verification: A fresh bounded decoder must replay the exact submitted user ID, same conversation ID and completed assistant ID. Matching text alone is insufficient. This candidate refreshes the sole in-memory temporary chain; it does not establish cross-client current-branch discovery.
privacy: Resume tokens and decoded temporary content remain memory-only; the diagnostic retains only status, counts and booleans.
